name: io.github.Servosity/afi-mcp
title: Afi MCP
description: The first CLI for Afi SaaS backup  -  full public-API coverage plus the fleet-wide coverage

environmentVariables.name: AFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the AFI_API_KEY credential for the Afi MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: AFI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Afi API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: AFI_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write to Afi: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

environmentVariables.name: AFI_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: AFI_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Afi requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: AFI_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
